newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank sells HRK 83 mln bills, rates flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank sells HRK 83 mln bills, rates flat.

text.p: Croatia's central bank sold 83 million kuna in 35- and 91-day bills on Wednesday.
Volume dropped from 338 million issued at last week's auction, but rates were unchanged.
The 35-day bills were issued at 8.0 percent on volume of 80 million kuna, and banks placed another three million in 91-day paper at 9.5 percent.
There were no bids for the 182-day bills, last issued at 17.50 percent.
Full results are on page NBHT. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
